content: Information Systems graduate with hands-on experience in data analysis, data processing, Python, and SQL. Graduated with Distinction as a Machine Learning Engineer from Coding Camp powered by DBS Foundation, with practical training in data preparation, exploratory data analysis, visualization, and predictive modeling. Skilled in analyzing and transforming data using Python, with foundational experience in Google Sheets. Strong analytical and documentation skills, with a passion for developing data-driven solutions and supporting informed decision-making.
